CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_student_learning_path_owned_reference
    ON student_learning_path (id, student_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_learning_path_command (
    idempotency_key UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    planning_request_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    student_id UUID NOT NULL,
    student_learning_path_id UUID NOT NULL,
    command_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (command_kind IN ('REPLAN','NO_GAP')),
    request_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    expected_path_version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (expected_path_version >= 1),
    result_path_version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (result_path_version >= 1),
    result_journey_version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (result_journey_version >= 1),
    response_json JSONB NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(response_json) = 'object'),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT fk_student_learning_path_command_owned_path
        FOREIGN KEY (student_learning_path_id, student_id)
        REFERENCES student_learning_path (id, student_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    UNIQUE (student_id, planning_request_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_learning_path_command_path
    ON student_learning_path_command (student_id, student_learning_path_id, created_at DESC);
